scope: Decorate and Shop detail static room preview only; no production deployment

userApproved.selection: A and then B each immediately update the foreground draft. No debounce, selection dropping, minimum dwell timer, or async preparation gate. React/display frames are not an artificial per-tap playback queue.
userApproved.background: Only obsolete speculative work is replaceable/cancellable; active native decodes may finish into the immutable public image cache, never publish selection state.
userApproved.outfit: Decorate uses static artwork, no Skia or outfit animation. Reuse a full-canvas precomposite when it already exists; do not delete useful Shop/Collection artwork.

rootCause: BurrowShop created an entire withRoomDesign snapshot and invoked prepareHomeArt on preview selections. This re-entered environment/Home/five-layer bunny/Skia/private-photo preparation and changed live Home retention, despite the preview itself being static. Rapid choices could leave earlier background preparations in flight.
implementation: Removed selection-triggered full Home preparation; the explicit purchase/Replace/apply-to-Home preparation and handoff remain unchanged.
Preview-only bunny uses one existing full-canvas bitmap with the same rig viewport geometry and explicit owner colour. Home animation and the layered native fallback are unchanged.

Dedicated preview preparation uses only current public slot artwork and the selected static outfit; no private-photo enumeration, environment refresh, Home retention mutation or Skia suite preparation.

Preview and product rail share two speculative decode workers and the existing common native decoder/cache. Already decoded immutable sources are reused. Pending obsolete preview jobs are replaced; focus/owner/variant/selection change and unmount cancel that preview's queued work.
Background preparation is scheduled after UI settles; the synchronous draft selection does not wait for it and late completion has no selection setter.

No source art regenerated or removed. All 38 brown/pink static images verified 1189x1323 with transparency; existing combined size 3090496 bytes. They serve other static surfaces, so removal would regress reuse.
preserved: Permanent product IDs and colour identity
Purchase/Replace confirmation and local durable intent

native.environment: iPhone 17 Pro Simulator / iOS 26.2 / minified Release Hermes host; actual BurrowShop, HomeArtPreview, HomeArtScene, cards, images and gestures; offline business fixture
native.interactions: 2 initial outfit choices, 20 warmed outfit choices and 20 cushion choices; observer recorded all 43 snapshots including initial room. Screenshots verified A outfit, then B outfit, then changed cushion; no movement of unrelated furniture or bunny proportions.
native.phaseStatistics: Cold-entry/initial outfit phase 59.79fps P95 17.50ms max 139.64ms (4 >50ms); warm outfit phase 59.68fps P95 17.52ms max 81.16ms (6 >50ms); furniture phase 59.46fps P95 17.53ms max 158.36ms (11 >50ms). Phase data includes time between taps; not tap-to-photon latency or isolated interaction-window statistics.
native.lifecycle: The initial QA-only Expo Router back call lacked a filesystem root and raised isReady TypeError. Fixed only the test router adapter to use its real React Navigation stack. Rebuilt/reinstalled the QA host; selection -> cancel, reopen -> selection -> reset -> cancel completed successfully twice. Product router was not changed.
native.limitations: No matched before/after baseline; the earlier 257ms animation stress is not this workload. JS RAF is not an independent compositor trace. Some >50ms frames remain and their individual CPU/GPU causes were not isolated. No zero-slow-frame or every-device guarantee. Physical iOS/Android and real account/payment end-to-end were not exercised.

release.standardsReason: Implements existing UI responsiveness/isolation requirements; no economic, ownership, notification, startup or acceptance contract changed.
